description: This Java class defines a Fragment called LogFragment that manages a LogView for displaying log data within an Android application. It creates a scrollable view containing the LogView, handles view inflation, sets styling and layout parameters, and ensures the view scrolls to the bottom when logs are updated.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that provides a view with a LogView inside a scrollable container, used for displaying log messages.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures a ScrollView containing a LogView, setting layout parameters, fonts, padding, and gravity.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates views, adds a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on log updates, and returns the root view of the fragment.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
